name: Atelier
description:
Atelier is the studio operating system for interior designers — projects, clients, vendors, product libraries, FF&E schedules, tasks, and time tracking in one place.

This connector gives Claude access to your studio's live records, so you can work on real project data from a conversation instead of switching to the app. Ask what is still unspecified on a project, add a product to a room schedule, pull a vendor product page into your library, check what is assigned to you this week, or start a timer on a task.

Everything is scoped to the studio your Atelier account belongs to, with the same role-based permissions as the web app. Records from other studios are invisible. Actions are attributed to you: a comment Claude posts appears under your name, and time entries it starts are yours.

All 47 tools are annotated read-only or write, so lookups run without interrupting you while changes are confirmed first. The connector does not delete records, does not expose invoicing or payments, and does not compose pinboards — that stays in the app.

Requires an Atelier account that belongs to a studio. Free to try at app.getatelier.design.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Atelier to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Atelier to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.getatelier.design/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Atelier MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Atelier lists 47 MCP tools, including add_products_to_schedule, add_task_todos, create_client, create_client_contact, create_phase, create_product, create_project, create_schedule, create_task, create_vendor, create_vendor_contact, and extract_product_from_url.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Atelier?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Atelier in creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Clipkit, Backstage, Interior Company, vivideo-prompt-builder, and gpt-war.
Atelier requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Atelier is developed by Atelier. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
